content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Split Payments ## slug: event-items-split-payments ## seoTitle: Split Payments ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End {{variable.Feature_SplitPayments}} allows users to define how to reconcile funds from different purchases (e.g., Tickets, Donations, Products) to specific gateway accounts connected to separate bank accounts. The benefits of using {{variable.Feature_SplitPayments}} include the following. * Allow {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to pay using both a primary {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} and a {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} during a single checkout experience. * Improve the user experience by eliminating the need to enter payment details multiple times. ## New Fields Three new payment gateway-related lookup fields are now available in addition to the existing {{variable.Object_Event}} object’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} and {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object’s {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Default}} fields. * Object: {{variable.Object_Event}} * Field Label: {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} * API Name: conference360__Donation_Payment_Gateway__c * Data Type: Lookup * Description: Use this field to configure a separate {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} that will process only Donations at a paid {{variable.Object_Event}}. **Note:** The gateway selected must use the same payment processor as the default {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} for the {{variable.Object_Event}}. * Object: {{variable.Object_EventItem}} * Field Label: {{variable.Field_EventItem_PaymentGateway}} * API Name: conference360__Payment_Gateway__c * Data Type: Lookup * Description: This {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} will process this {{variable.Object_EventItem}}. If blank, the default {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} for the {{variable.Object_Event}} will be used. * Object: {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} * Field Label: {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultDonationGatewa}} * API Name: conference360__Default_Donation_Gateway__c * Field Type: Checkbox * Description: If checked and Split Payments is enabled, this gateway will be used as the Donation Gateway for Events. When separating Donations from the other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s, Donations will use the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}}, and all other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s will use the standard {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} on the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. If you want to designate a default donation gateway, use the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}’s {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultDonationGatewa}} field. Use the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}’s {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Default}} field for all other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s. ## New Custom Setting The new Blackthorn | Events Settings custom setting, {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}}, turns on the {{variable.Feature_SplitPayments}} feature, which separates Donations from other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s. When enabled, Donations are funneled into their own gateway account and each Donation has its own {{variable.Object_Transaction}} that is separate from the other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s. This setting also means users can stop manually reconciling funds from a single bank account, where the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is paid, into separate bank accounts. * Location: Custom Settings > Blackthorn | Events Settings * Field Label: {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}} * API Name: conference360__Enable_Split_Donations_Payments__c * Type: Checkbox * Default Value: False (not checked) * Description: Enable this setting to configure a second gateway account to separate Donations from other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s. ### How It Works If {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}} is enabled, the following will occur. * {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket,” “Guest,” and “Other” (Products) will be assigned to the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s (primary) {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}}. * {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Donation” will be assigned to the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}}. If {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}} is not enabled, all {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s will be assigned to the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s (primary) {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}}. ## Default Gateways Users can also use the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}'s {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultDonationGatewa}} field to select a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record as the default donation gateway. By setting a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}'s {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultDonationGatewa}} field to “True” (checked), the Events app will automatically populate the primary and donation {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s with their respective default gateways when creating an {{variable.Object_Event}}. For this to occur, the primary default gateway and the default donation gateway must be linked to the same provider (e.g., Stripe). When using default gateways, the following will occur if a user enables the {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}} custom setting and creates an {{variable.Object_Event}}. * The system automatically populates the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} field with the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} marked as the default. * If the {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} field is blank, the system populates the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} field with the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} marked as the {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultDonationGatewa}}. If the {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}} custom setting is disabled, only the {{variable.Object_Event}}'s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} lookup field is populated with the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} record designated as the default. ## Event Builder Updates When creating an {{variable.Object_Event}} with the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}, users can add a separate {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} for a Donation plus the gateway for their Ticket(s). When the {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}} custom setting is enabled, users can select a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} for a Donation in the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} section’s {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} lookup field. Only gateways that match the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} will be visible when selecting a gateway in the {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} field. If a user creates a new {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} for the Donation, the {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} provider must match the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s default {{variable.Field_ETEvent_PaymentGateway}} provider. Users will only see the {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} field after they select the primary {{variable.Field_EventItem_PaymentGateway}}. Once the {{variable.Object_Event}} is saved, the {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} selection will appear in the {{variable.Object_Event}}’s {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} field. ## Behind the Scenes ### Payment Gateways The updated checkout method with the {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} will process multiple {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s successfully while maintaining support for a single {{variable.Object_Transaction}}. #### Stripe and Authorize.net An updated process will generate an encryption key for two-way (symmetric) encryption of credit card data. Encryption keys are stored temporarily and removed immediately after tokenization to minimize unwanted exposure. The primary and donation {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s will be tokenized simultaneously with distinct gateway credentials to ensure data security. Encrypted credit card data will be tokenized. Once the process is complete, the data will be removed from the cache, and the corresponding tokens for each credit card will be used in the checkout process. #### Stripe, Authorize.net, and Spreedly For each registration using a credit card or ACH, a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} will be created in each {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} and used to process the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} in each gateway. ### Invoice/Line Item Updates After all {{variable.Object_LineItem}} totals are calculated, users will see a list of all {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s with separate amounts and gateways. {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s with {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Donation” will cause the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} to include two {{variable.Object_LineItem}}s – one for the Donation and one for the other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}. The related {{variable.Object_Transaction}} list on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} will also include two {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s, each with a different {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. ## How to Use ### Pre-Requisites * Your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} must be with Stripe or Authorize.net. Currently, no other gateways are supported. * ACH {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} types are not supported. {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s can only use card {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}s. ### Start Here 1. Check {{variable.CS_EnableSplitDonationPayments}} in the Blackthorn | Event Settings custom settings. 2. Create an {{variable.Object_Event}} with two {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s - one “Main event ticket” and one “Donation.” 3. Set up the primary and donation {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s. 1. Add the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} for Donations in the {{variable.Object_Event}}s {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} field. 2. Add the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} for all other {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s in the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_EventItem_PaymentGateway}} field. 4. Set one or more {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s as the default gateway for each {{variable.Object_EventItem}} type. 5. Complete any additional formatting for your {{variable.Object_Event}}. 6. Publish the {{variable.Object_Event}}. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} completes the checkout process with at least one “Main event ticket” and one “Donation” ticket, the Event Organizer will see two new {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}, each processed by the appropriate {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}.
